name: El Dorado Exchange
rootCause: El Dorado Exchange on Arbitrum was reported exploited on 2023-05-30 through a manipulable price path in its swap or oracle logic. DefiLlama records $120,000 lost, while secondary reports describe a larger gross extraction, partial fund returns, and a disputed whitehat framing. Manipulable price path in the oracle-backed swap logic.
